Contributors: Cook, James, 1728-1779; Delamarche, Charles François, 1740-1817, cartographer, publisher; Dussy, E., engraver; Robert de Vaugondy, Didier, 1723-1786, cartographer
Publication statement: A Paris : Chez le cit. Delamarche géographe, rue du Foin Saint-Jacques au collége de mstre. Gervais, [1786]

Relief shown pictorially. "Carte corrigée, augmentée ... en 1786." Shows routes of Capt. Cook's 3 circumnavigations. Includes illustrated cartouche. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault. AACR2: 100; 650/1 700/1; 700/3
Shows routes of Capt. Cook's 3 circumnavigations.
